sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-04-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01')

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST(COUNT(r.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cities c JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Qassim'

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN cust_orders co ON co.customer_id = ca.customer_id WHERE ca.avg_h > (SELECT avg_h FROM overall) AND co.n >= 6

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(r.rev,0) - COALESCE(f.refunds,0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.employee_id = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH item_rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, oi.id AS item_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01'), item_ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(ir.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM item_rev ir JOIN employees e ON e.id = ir.employee_id LEFT JOIN item_ref rf ON rf.order_item_id = ir.item_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

WITH item_rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, oi.id AS item_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01'), item_ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(ir.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM item_rev ir JOIN employees e ON e.id = ir.employee_id LEFT JOIN item_ref rf ON rf.order_item_id = ir.item_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT region_name, ROUND((rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 100.0 / rev_2024, 2) AS growth_pct FROM rev WHERE rev_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 1.0 / rev_2024 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'wholesale'

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH item_rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, oi.id AS item_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01'), item_ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(ir.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM item_rev ir JOIN employees e ON e.id = ir.employee_id LEFT JOIN item_ref rf ON rf.order_item_id = ir.item_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
